title: Four levers, one trick
subtitle: Your effort, money or time, multiplied instead of spent.

items.label: Capital
items.note: Multiplies money. It works while you sleep.

items.label: Code
items.note: Multiplies time. Write once, run a million times.

items.label: People
items.note: Multiplies reach. Ten do in a week what one can't in a year.

items.label: Media
items.note: Multiplies voice. The cheapest lever to start with.

takeaway: Not harder work. A longer branch.
